answer: Here is one concrete wall: Cross-chain liquidity position age. It works because a position open on two chains for a year, and the glacier it creates is a cost that scales with the size of the farm. Because a position open on two chains for a year, a fresh identity starts with nothing: it must earn its standing the slow way, while the harbor for an established agent is already paid and proven. The price is not in coins but in friction: each fake needs its own a position open on two chains for a year, and the signal of that friction is a hundred small errands no script can automate away.
